description: Buy a token on any supported chain (Solana, Sui, Ethereum, Base, Arbitrum, BSC, etc.) using the best DEX route.

amount.description: Amount of native token to spend, e.g. '0.1' for 0.1 SOL

apiKey.description: GDEX API key for managed-custody buys (with sessionPrivateKey).

dex.description: Preferred DEX (raydium, orca, uniswap-v3, cetus, odos, etc.)

sessionPrivateKey.description: Managed-custody session private key (from sign-in). Required for EVM managed swaps — routes through the session-signed purchase_v2 flow.

slippage.description: Max slippage tolerance in percent. Default: 1

tokenAddress.description: Contract address of the token to buy

name: buy_token
